text:
nina-cs: quick weekly check-in for Tidal (edge-vpc across regions). seeing a small uptick in KMS latency in eu-west and intermittent connectivity alarms in ap-southeast. sharing notes + next steps.

ashwin: saw KMS RPC p95 jump to ~420ms around 02:10 UTC yesterday, retry storm for a few minutes. logs show repeated TLS handshakes failing, HSM reconnects every ~30s. no full decrypt failures though.

sam: customer impact? any API errors surfaced to prod?

maya: 503s on a small subset of dedicated nodes in ap-southeast during the same window. rate ~0.05% overall but spike coincided with KMS latencies. did a rolling restart of 3 pods, errors dropped to baseline.

ashwin: confirmed: KMS timeouts -> request retries -> surge on inference nodes -> transient 503s. KMS metrics: \`kms_request_latency_p95{region="eu-west1"} = 420ms\` and brief error rate bump to 0.8%. HSM logs: \`reconnect attempt: code=ECONNRESET\`.

nina-cs: thanks. usage/spend note: Tidal's monthly token usage is +12% week-over-week (onboarding new model variants). cost burn is borderline for their committed tier; flagged for renewal discussion.

sam: we should surface an action item to Solutions for prompt batching/kv-cache tuning to reduce KMS pressure. also, ask infra to check HSM network path (NAT gateway flaps?)

maya: putting the quick commands I used to validate node state:

```
# check KMS health from inside VPC
curl -sS http://10.0.12.5:8080/healthz | jq .
# tail HSM proxy logs
kubectl logs -n infra hsm-proxy-1 -f | grep -i reconnect
```

ops-bot: incident-note created: INC-2026-1893 (assigned to ashwin). pinging infra oncall. :rotating_light:

ashwin: short-term mitigations: 1) enable 2s client-side KMS timeout/failover, 2) limit retry jitter to avoid thundering herd, 3) add KMS-targeted rate limiting on edge ingress for Tidal key.

nina-cs: long-term asks for eng-infra: 1) validate HSM NAT path + peering metrics, 2) propose HSM proxy HA (2nd replica + sticky sessions), 3) telemetry: correlate KMS latency with node 503s in Console.

sam: i'll add these to the renewal risk brief — note that customer is onboarding three more teams next month, so stability + cost control are critical.

maya: leaving a short checklist for CS enablement: update runbook with KMS playbook, share kv-cache tuning guide, schedule a 30m run-through with Tidal SREs next Tue.

nina-cs: thanks all. i'll send a summary to the account (cc: solutions) and schedule the enablement session. will keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
